title.narrative: ACTORS OF URBAN DIALOG: Growth of activism in Uzbekistan

description.narrative: Overall objective of the project is to support civil society actors, in particular urban activists, in strengthening democratic participation in Uzbekistan. By creating the network of civil society actors and urban activists, we will create a network of multipliers who will transform the way people participate in decision-making process, as a bottom-up approach, by learning how to establish dialogue processes.

title.narrative: Activation and enhancement of knowledge, skill and selfefficacy (though civic educational program and infrastructure) of urban activists, young people and civil society actors in small towns of Uzbekistan, aimed at improving the quality of life of people in small towns.

description.narrative: The educational program consists of: two training programs based on Human Rights Based Approach and two study visits to Germany (based on case studies). implemented pilot testing and development of teaching materials and toolkit by the participants, together with experts consultation. application to the local projects, training and coaching to ensure knowledge transfer, especially of multipliers to less experienced young people inside and outside the region (peertopeer education).
